subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

VALIANT
solution: The correct answer is '**Cowardly**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Valiant**' is '**Cowardly**'. • **Valiant**: full of courage and not afraid. (साहसी और निर्भीक) • *Example: She died last year after a **valiant** battle with cancer.* • **Cowardly**: lacking courage. (साहस की कमी) • *Example: He is **cowardly** in war, and on one occasion was shut up for years in a huge brazen pot.* **Correct Answer:__** *Cowardly.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning** of other words: • **Worthy**: good enough for something or to have something. (किसी बात या वस्‍तु या कुछ धारण करने के योग्‍य) • **Gallant**: (of a person or their behaviour) brave; heroic. ((किसी व्यक्ति या उनके व्यवहार का) बहादुर; वीर रस) • **Barren**: (used about land or soil) not good enough for plants to grow on. ((भूमि या मिट्टी) पौधों वृद्धि के लिए अनुपयुक्त, ऊसर, बंजर) 3e:Tbab, The correct answer is '**Lucid**'.
